summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a board-approved 1-for-50 reverse share split effective September 8, 2026, to regain compliance with Nasdaq minimum bid price requirements. Issued shares will reduce from 77,492,393 to approximately 1,549,848; fractional shares of 0.5 or higher round up, lower fractions are cancelled. The ordinary shares continue trading on Nasdaq under ALP with a new CUSIP. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation; it does not involve restructuring, going-private, or other listed categories. Watch for Nasdaq compliance confirmation and post-split trading performance.
